    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg and x!=wall)
    sc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==sc}

    for r in range(h): out[r][wallc]=wall
    return out
